Name: Courtyard Furniture
Author: StarLight2024
Description:
Sixteen furniture pieces added to the Furniture Catalogue. Order them right away - nothing to unlock, nothing to craft. Names come in English and Simplified Chinese and follow your game language. All sprites are hand-drawn on the game's native 16px grid.

[b]Good to know[/b]

[list]
[*]The Pastoral Sculpture is a painted wooden bird on a post - it won't keep crows off your crops. The pet bed just looks nice; the cat will ignore it.[/*]
[*]Seven pieces can go outdoors: bench, dining table, stone table, stone lantern, rug, washing basin and the sculpture. The other nine are indoor furniture, same rules as vanilla.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Requirements and install[/b]

Stardew Valley 1.6+, SMAPI 4.0+, Content Patcher 2.0+. Unzip into
[code]Mods[/code]so the folder reads
[code]Mods\[CP] Courtyard Furniture[/code], then start the game through SMAPI. The pieces are in the catalogue the first time you open it.

Adding this to an existing save is fine. Removing it later deletes the pieces you placed, including the contents of the three storage pieces - keep a backup.

[b]Compatibility[/b]

Content Patcher data and its own textures only. No DLL, doesn't need Furniture Framework. Every ID starts with
[code]qqc_[/code]and only
[code]Data/Furniture[/code]gets new entries - nothing vanilla is touched.

[b]Credits[/b]

Sprites, data and page by StarLight2024. Built on Content Patcher by Pathoschild.

[size=4][b]中文说明[/b][/size]

给游戏自带的「家具目录」加了 16 件田园风家具，打开目录就能下单，不用解锁、不用做。显示名跟随游戏语言（中/英）。

[list]
[*]能坐：藤编扶手椅、木矮凳、庭院长凳[/*]
[*]储物（各 36 格）：储物陶缸、谷仓木箱、草药搁架[/*]
[*]天黑自己亮：煤油灯、石灯笼[/*]
[*]其他：草编地毯（可踩、上面能摆家具）、麦田油画、草药标本画（挂墙）、洗衣木盆、田园雕塑、宠物软窝[/*]
[/list]
庭院长凳、原木长餐桌、石砌圆桌、石灯笼、草编地毯、洗衣木盆、田园雕塑这 7 件室内外都能放，其余 9 件只能放屋里。

田园雕塑只是一只彩绘木鸟，驱不了乌鸦；宠物软窝也一样，猫狗不会去睡。

需要 1.6+、SMAPI 4.0+、Content Patcher 2.0+。解压到 Mods 里用 SMAPI 启动即可。中途加装没问题；中途卸载会把摆出去的家具连同里面存的东西一起删掉，先备份存档。
